entries.subject: Shape
entries.finding: A sphere of the model radius (Sutlieff et al. 2026); no image resolves the planet.

entries.subject: Orbit and mass
entries.finding: Sutlieff, Bonse et al. (2026), arXiv:2606.23801: the published semi-major axis, inclination and node, with a circular display orbit phased to their six measured positions.

entries.subject: A false color from three measured bands
entries.finding: Shown in infrared false color from its measured flux in F444W 4.35 µm, F410M 4.072 µm, ERIS L′ 3.78 µm (Sutlieff, Bonse et al. (2026), arXiv:2606.23801; zero points from the SVO Filter Profile Service).
